title: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
description: A magnificent castle of moving staircases, enchanted ceilings, secret passages, and centuries of magical history.

title: Diagon Alley
description: A lively wizarding street filled with wandmakers, bookshops, apothecaries, and shops full of extraordinary things.

title: The Forbidden Forest
description: An ancient forest bordering Hogwarts, home to remarkable magical creatures and mysteries best approached with care.

title: Hogsmeade
description: A charming all-wizard village known for cosy inns, sweet shops, and a welcome escape from school life.

title: Platform Nine and Three-Quarters
description: The hidden platform at King's Cross where the Hogwarts Express begins its journey north.

title: Ministry of Magic
description: The complex heart of magical government, concealed from the non-magical world beneath the streets of London.
